description: A context menu triggered by right-click (or long-press on touch devices). Built on Radix UI ContextMenu which provides the full WAI-ARIA menu pattern. Once open, keyboard behavior is identical to DropdownMenu.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the next item
Moves focus to the previous item
Opens a submenu when focused on a submenu trigger
Closes a submenu and returns focus to the parent menu
Moves focus to the first item
Moves focus to the last item
Focuses the next item matching typed characters

focus.notes: Focus moves to the first menu item when the menu opens. Arrow keys move focus between items. On close, focus returns to the element that was focused before the context menu was triggered. Focus is trapped within the menu while it is open.

announcements: Menu items are announced with their role (menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio)
Checked state is announced for checkbox and radio items
Disabled items are announced as dimmed/unavailable
screenReader.notes: Context menus are not discoverable via keyboard alone — the trigger area does not indicate that a context menu is available. Ensure critical actions are accessible through other means.

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA — menu uses popover-foreground on popover background
contrast.ui: Focus indicator and item highlight meet 3:1 contrast ratio

consumerResponsibilities: Never place essential actions only in a context menu — they are not keyboard-discoverable
Provide alternative access to context menu actions via buttons or menus
Use ContextMenuLabel to group related items
Avoid deeply nested submenus for usability
